profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Hitachi Rail STS
profile.summary: Software developer with experience ranging from being the lead on five-person teams to being a member of enterprise departments of over 100. Proponent of clean code, modularization, automated testing, and continuous integration. Desire to invest in others and in turn be mentored, so that our collective work will make something great.

positions.title: Software Mentor
positions.description: Mentored five students virtually who were enrolled in an online coding bootcamp focused on web development technologies. They learned the basics of Ruby on Rails, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Linux, git, and AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Write and test C# plug-ins and Windows-forms for Revit drawing program (similar to AutoCAD)
* Design components and services in Angular; markup and styling in HTML/SCSS
* Set up and test controllers, entities, and dtos in ASP.NET core microservices architecture
* Debug, interface with and deploy Azure functions, Cosmos DB instances, and Service Bus Queues
* Style pages with flexbox, bootstrap, and SCSS

positions.title: Lead Software Developer, Carrier Integrations, US Rating
positions.locationName: Lincoln, NE and remotely from Pittsburgh, PA
positions.description:
• Mentor three junior developers on OO principles, design patterns, and testing practices
• Tech liaison and consultant on larger projects between our team and three other dev teams
• Review code written by peers and supervisors, focusing on readability and efficiency
• Participate in weekly stand-ups in an Agile environment with both local and remote employees
• Automate workflows and menial tasks with code so team members can have more throughput
• Maintain Linux servers and expand rating API for features, speed, and security
• Designed new integration and regression test suite using Mocha
• Oversaw platform upgrades from node.js v0.10 to v6.9 across four different repositories
• Migrated database infrastructure from AWS SimpleDB to AWS RDS instances (MySQL)
• Described our cloud architecture from a high-level overview using UML on github wiki

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Integrated our servers with 19 carriers’ servers/APIs (both SOAP and REST) using node.js
• Devised test suite which became basis for mapping software now used by 10 employees
• Helped design and maintain mapping software using Ruby on Rails and Angular.js
• Transformed xml documents to carrier specifications using xsl

positions.title: GTA/Teacher
positions.description:
Instructor of Record:
- Business Calculus
- Calculus 3
- Geometry Matters
- Linear Algebra
- Contemporary Mathematics 
- College Algebra
- Trigonometry 

Recitation Instructor:
- Calculus 1

Grader:
- Algebraic Topology
- Business Calculus

Other Experiences:
- Research in operator algebras.
- Taught in Primarily Math program through the Center for Science, Math, and Computer Education during summer of 2011.
- Was involved in "Hopkins Seminar," a year-long research seminar with other graduate students and faculty members at UNL, and Michael J. Hopkins, form Harvard University.
- Student member of search committee for a new faculty member in Mathematics Education.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: I had a one semester appointment with the CSMCE in the spring of 2012. I did a lot of mixed work: grading, preparing group projects for in-service teachers, writing blogs, and other random math-related jobs.

company.name: Center for Science, Math, and Computer Education

positions.title: Undergraduate Assistant
positions.description: I worked as an undergraduate assistant for Dr. Angela Spalsbury and Dr. Nate Ritchey, professors in the mathematics department at YSU. My main job was helping plan YSU's annual "MathFest" event. This included maintaining the registration website and database, along with emailing teachers, and planning sessions for students to attend. Apart from MathFest, I helped conceive new problems for the textbook "Calculus with Applications," of which Dr. Ritchey is a co-author. It's a pretty popular book - I just taught a Business Calculus course out of it at UNL!

volunteerExperiences.description: Took apart bikes donated to the co-op and helped fix bikes brought in.
Take apart bikes, fix bikes, price bikes, clean and organize shop

publications.title: A Note on Disjoint Covering Systems - Variations on a 2002 AIME Problem
